title: Joseph is thrown into the well and sold to Egypt
description: Jacob sends Joseph from the valley of Hebron to check on his brothers who are shepherding near Shechem, and he finds them in Dothan. The brothers plot to kill him, but Reuben persuades them to throw him into a pit instead. At Judah's suggestion, they sell him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. They dip his robe in the blood of a goat and deceive Jacob into believing that a wild animal has killed him. Joseph is taken to Egypt and sold to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
